validity.recommendation: Check the start year: operator says construction ended October 1960, sheet says 1961
validity.researcher_notes: The operator history page says the pipeline is 606 km, 820 mm, and that construction ended on 25 October 1960. The sheet start year is 1961. The same page says the pipeline is now a distribution line. Length and diameter match the sheet.

fills.researcher_notes: The history page of Gazprom Transgaz Nizhny Novgorod says the Saratov to Gorky gas pipeline is 606 kilometers long and 820 millimeters in diameter. The sheet value of 606 is the same. This is one source from the operator.
The history page of Gazprom Transgaz Nizhny Novgorod gives 820 millimeters for the Saratov to Gorky pipeline. The sheet value of 820 is the same.

The operator's history page says construction of the Saratov to Gorky pipeline was finished on 25 October 1960, and the sheet start year is 1961. The page does not give a commissioning year that matches 1961, so it does not support the sheet value. The sheet value stays. A person should check whether 1960 or 1961 is the right start year.

The Pochinki line operating unit of Gazprom Transgaz Nizhny Novgorod lists sections of the Saratov, Gorky and Cherepovets pipeline among the main pipelines it runs. The page is an archived copy from March 2025. The history page of the same operator says the pipeline is now a distribution line, which is a caveat on how it is classified.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: The operator lists sections of the pipeline in its current area. The history page says it is now a distribution line, not a trunk line. No source says it is closed.

cross_row_leads.note: The operator history page says the Saratov to Gorky pipeline is now a distribution line. A later search could check whether GEM should still track it as a trunk pipeline.
